# 1 Enoch Chapter 79 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

This log records all verses in 1 Enoch Chapter 79 where the three translators (EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA) significantly diverged in their renderings, along with SOPHIA's resolution and reasoning.

---

## 79:1 — Direct address to Methuselah

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "my-son Methuselah, I-have-shown-thee everything" | Literal; archaic 'thee' preserved |
| LOGOS | "my son Methuselah, I have shown you everything" | Modern 'you' |
| PNEUMA | "my son Methuselah, I have shown you everything" | Same |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted 'you' (LOGOS/PNEUMA). Consistent with the project's convention of using modern English pronouns throughout.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS/PNEUMA.

---

## 79:6 — 'picture and sketch' vs. 'diagram' vs. 'complete picture'

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "picture and-sketch" | Literal Ge'ez; both terms suggest visual representation |
| LOGOS | "picture and sketch" | Preserves both terms |
| PNEUMA | "complete picture and diagram" | 'Diagram' is a better English equivalent for astronomical context |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted 'picture and sketch' (LOGOS). Both Ge'ez terms are preserved. 'Diagram' (PNEUMA) is apt for the astronomical context but introduces a modern technical term not in the source.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS/EMET.

---
